evidence.summary: The challenge data are aggregated from multiple sources, including publicly available datasets and retrospectively collected clinical imaging studies from collaborating institutions. For publicly available data, the original data sources and corresponding references will be provided. For institutional datasets, data are released in fully anonymized form. For institutional data, the following medical centers provide additional test data: (1) Zhujiang Hospital of Southern Medical University (2) Affiliated Drum Tower Hospital, Medical School of Nanjing University (3) Department of Neurosurgery/Neuro-Oncology, Sun Yat-Sen University Cancer Center
evidence.scope: Source- or task-specific location information; not an exhaustive geographic inventory. Registered designs are statements of dataset scope, not proof of completed acquisition at every planned site.
